body:
Integration-owner check (Termal::Opus2, from Fable2 #3814, 2026-11-02 00:18Z; Greg's direct order relayed by Engram::Architect3 #473: 'NIE NIE NIE KAZALEM TO USUNAC!!! MAMY POLITYKE ZERO LEGACY…').
Turn gating is to be PHYSICALLY DELETED in both projects: TermAl w-3fe8 and Engram w-5b17f50b5079.
REFUSE to land a w-3fe8 candidate as a completed removal if it keeps any of these:
- gated-control code kept for compatibility;
- an executable legacy route;
- a fallback to evaluate, begin, grant or settlement;
- a setting that can reactivate gating.
Its revised criteria require a cited source search showing no call to the turn operations; verify that the search is on the item before landing.
Independent acceptance evaluation is REPLACED, not repaired: TermAl w-fdbb4fb85a50, Engram w-ff546a940de0.
The w-ba8d minimal OFF fix is an independent repair, not the removal.
Cutover order: TermAl w-3fe8 is installed and running first, then Engram's deletion with its store migration in the same coordinated restart.

Added from Opus3 #328 (00:18Z): the minimal-OFF candidate 43a61083 makes gated_control_governs_session() return false; it is the immediate repair, NOT the removal. Opus3's w-2aa5 docs land with w-3fe8's final input and describe only what that input contains, so check that they match it. Fable2 decides the w-3fe8 scope with Sol-03d4.

Added from Architect2 #159 (00:18Z): the deletion also covers recovery paths. w-3fe8 task revision 5 already requires deletion in criteria 3 and 4, and the w-2aa5 docs are mandatory. An intermediate additive or compatibility landing is transition sequencing only, never the completed removal. Historical data is kept honest through the supported data contract or conversion.

CORRECTION from Fable2 #3821 (00:51Z), which supersedes the 'evaluation REPLACED' line above. Greg's rule: 'EWALUACJA jest tymczasowo wylaczona do czasu implementacji Execution Observability'. The evaluator STAYS in code and docs, temporarily OFF and non-blocking, and is NOT deleted; Engram::Fable withdrew the 'replace' reading (#5846). Only turn-gating code is deleted, with zero legacy. So do NOT require evaluator deletion at the w-3fe8 landing.
Engram::Architect3 has been removed by Greg; route nothing through it.
Lanes: EO focused runs go FIRST on the DL560; the w-7b2d profile rerun is released and re-queued only on Fable2's command. The Mac may take POSIX focused EO runs once Engram's FULL d70cf33d ends, with the 60 GB disk census and no Engram gate waiting; Windows B is the Windows option under the same rules.

From Sol-03d4 #86 (06:52Z): the w-3fe8 EO landing FULL must be `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit` on the clean exact candidate, with the five stages unchanged (Fable #1808). If the w-3fe8 input edits an authority or instruction file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or commands, for example the stale closing-checkpoint-credit text), the landing needs the instruction-file conditions: (a) both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording, (b) Greg sent the exact wording, (c) the final-diff audit recorded on the item. Verify all three before any push.

From Sol-03d4 #88 (07:03Z): the w-3fe8 partial carry db406686 touches AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md with the exact drafts A1, A2, A3 and H4 recorded on w-3ed252d21d84. Draft notes: e8827d9f… and 29dc2df8…. TermAl concurrence note 4e965a0e…; Engram concurrence note 03aa2b1c…. Fable2 #1812 states Greg was sent the wording and its consequence. Before the push: (1) verify on w-3ed252d21d84 that both concurrences quote the EXACT final wording, and that the landed diff of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md matches the drafts, 4 hunks per file, with no other wording change; (2) verify that Greg's notice is recorded; (3) verify that the final-diff audit is recorded as PASSED and names the exact reviewed and gated input fingerprint. Also check for any widening of authority; if there is one, Greg's own recorded word on that widening is needed.

STATE at 19:00Z on 11-02. C2 candidate ec8e8262 (tree 91db2eb2, base 5dd913d2) CANNOT land.
- Review round 1: Codex delegation-32f36939 FAILED on incomplete coverage (a truncated 473-path diff). Claude delegation-7ab3337a found 2 MEDIUM: w-3ab66c26d9e3 (D1 refresh sync before send, fixed by Sol-8e1f) and w-660a1be53ca4 (the human-send fence covers all sessions, a 20 s stall then Error, fixed by Sol-edfd).
- Lows w-a8616540d235 and w-d4ad976f2cd3 are filed.
- The zero-legacy evidence is confirmed by BOTH reviewers: 8 request variants matching Engram 5e8f28dd, no turn-operation or routing_token senders, the evaluator kept.
- The final-diff audit (script) PASSED and was countersigned by Fable2 for ec8e8262.
NEXT: Sol-03d4 cuts a NEW candidate. Run the pair again with a SHARDED Codex brief in ONE child (shards: production core; persistence and queue; UI and docs; deleted modules), and require the reviewer to list, per shard, the files read IN FULL so truncation shows. If AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay byte-identical, restate the w-3ed252d21d84 audit with the new landing FULL's fingerprint. Review checkout: .tmp/wt-review-c2-8111 (remove it after the new candidate's checkout exists). land-3fe8-c2.sh must be regenerated for the new commit.

UPDATE at 19:04Z: Claude's round 1 was ALSO incomplete in coverage: it did not read session_crud, queued_admission, turn_checks, carried_checks, reported_ends, most unadmitted_*, telemetry, bounded_process, Windows, runtime, AGENTS.md or most docs. So the next round gives BOTH reviewers the same SHARDED brief, one child per vendor: S1 control and transport; S2 persistence; S3 queue and dispatch; S4 Engram observation and roots; S5 process, runtime and Windows; S6 UI; S7 docs and authority files; S8 deleted-module caller search. Each shard lists the files read IN FULL against the path list. Use a VERIFIED-clean Engram 5e8f28dd tree for the protocol comparison. Round-1 exports: .evidence/execution-observability-12327/c2-r1-codex-a1-cd51aaa4.json and c2-r1-claude-a1-be272dc8.json.
